name: sit_bench
text: A person sits quietly upright on a bench, both thighs pointing forward in parallel, both lower legs vertical, both soles flat on the floor and both knees comfortably apart. Both hands lie on the lap. Keep legs uncrossed and feet planted throughout. Subtle breathing only.
